n1167a5af9a.headline: India plans sale of debt-laden national carrier Air India
n1167a5af9a.summary: India plans to sell its entire 100% stake in national carrier Air India to shore up falling government revenues amid an economic slowdown. An initial attempt last year failed to attract a single bidder.
n1167a5af9a.why: Air India is the state-owned national carrier, and a full privatisation would transfer control of a major airline and affect the government's revenue and disinvestment plans.

nd1b29702f7.headline: Kapil Wadhawan diverted Rs 2,186 crore from DHFL to buy Mirchi properties
nd1b29702f7.summary: An agency investigation found Kapil Wadhawan diverted Rs 2,186 crore from DHFL to buy three Worli properties belonging to the Mirchi family. His brother Dheeraj held several meetings with Iqbal Mirchi.
nd1b29702f7.why: Dewan Housing Finance (DHFL) is an Indian mortgage lender whose financial troubles drew regulatory scrutiny. Fund diversion allegations affect lender governance and creditor recovery.

n2220d615e1.headline: Prague coalition aired disagreements. No one is leaving, the city will review the multi-billion contract - Novinky
n2220d615e1.summary: Prague city officials agreed to review a 14.6 billion crown contract for metro train servicing following criticism and coalition disagreements.
n2220d615e1.why: Large public contracts affect municipal budgets and local suppliers; scrutiny may impact contract terms and future public procurement practices.

nbfc9623e01.headline: Equatorial Guinea ready to engage with OPEC if coronavirus affect oil market | Headlines
nbfc9623e01.summary: Equatorial Guinea expressed readiness to engage with OPEC amid concerns over the coronavirus impact on the oil market, following comments by Saudi Energy Minister.
nbfc9623e01.why: Equatorial Guinea is an OPEC member; its cooperation affects oil supply decisions, which influence global oil prices and energy markets.

nc7c65baf0a.headline: IMF: Kuwaiti economy slowed growth by 0.7% in 2019
nc7c65baf0a.summary: The IMF reported that Kuwait's non-oil sector grew in 2019, but declines in oil prices and production cuts pressured the oil sector, resulting in overall GDP growth of about 0.7%.
nc7c65baf0a.why: Kuwait's economy is heavily dependent on oil, so fluctuations in oil prices and production directly influence its economic growth and fiscal health, important for investors in the region.

n19b78629b3.headline: With participation of an Egyptian company.. Minister of Transport reveals date for construction of first dry port
n19b78629b3.summary: Egypt's Minister of Transport announced that the construction date for the country's first dry port, involving an Egyptian company, will be revealed soon.
n19b78629b3.why: Infrastructure projects like dry ports enhance trade logistics and economic development, impacting Egypt's trade efficiency and investment climate.

n87b3fdc6b5.headline: Demand Fears Are Driving Today’s Oil Markets
n87b3fdc6b5.summary: Oil prices dropped close to a three-month low due to fears of weak demand growth linked to the coronavirus outbreak in China, raising concerns about slower economic activity.
n87b3fdc6b5.why: Oil demand is closely tied to global economic activity; disruptions in China, a major consumer, can significantly affect oil prices and energy markets worldwide.
n87b3fdc6b5.why_moved: Concerns over reduced oil demand from China due to coronavirus fears caused a sell-off in oil futures, pushing prices down.
